name: sprite-motion-kit
description: Author game-character walk and death sprites from pose references, with local atlas export and visual review.

interface.shortDescription: Create and inspect character walk and death sprite sheets.
interface.longDescription: Use side-profile mannequin poses and character artwork with the host AI's image-generation tool, then export transparent frames, atlases and a synchronized offline reviewer. Includes CC0 motion references; no model access or generation credits.
defaultPrompt: Make a side-profile walking sprite sheet from this character and show the synchronized review.
Animate this character falling into a full-size corpse that stays on the final frame.
Inspect this walking loop against its pose reference and export an aligned atlas.
